title: [RM-901] Add index on TripObservation.captured_at for nightly queries
author: Brayan244
body:
Nightly forecast queries filter TripObservation by captured_at and are slow. Adds an index.

Linear: https://linear.app/reservamos/issue/RM-901
derived_from: Inverts the SAFE real migration 0211_busline_seat_type_index.py (which correctly uses atomic=False + AddIndexConcurrently) into an UNSAFE in-transaction AddIndex on the large TripObservation table (~2.08B rows).
